name: Tibi seek-order acceptance (scripts/rig3d-seek.py)
purpose: Reproduce history-dependent Tibi frames with named skin, feet, scene, split-camera and anatomy-mode presets. Compare fresh and revisited state/pixels and write labelled sheets, thumbnails and a pass/fail report.
capabilities: --baseline <report.json> adds start-state verdicts to the current report
assets/fitness/lab3d/seek-bench.html drives named figures on a paused GSAP timeline with suppressed-callback seeks
One browser under the host lock; cold-build and warm-frame timing, exact pixel differences and projection-camera object counts; normal fingerprints join position and colour checks
Twenty cases per profile: original temporal cases plus shoulder twist, overhead reach, deep flexion and partially open cutaways; JS heap sample is not process peak RAM
--set locality separately checks both bodies for off-window anatomy pixels; --unclipped-control disables the clip in memory to prove the actual pixel gate detects the defect

compatibility.runtime: Python 3.12, existing Playwright and Pillow, Chrome with SwiftShader
compatibility.notes: Distance is the current development default; legacy remains explicit. Normal-buffer parity is included. Mac run pending; this is temporal evidence, not an anatomy or creative sign-off.

security.notes: Loads workspace-owned assets and writes only to the requested report directory. No install or external asset download.

installation.instructions: Workspace tool; uses the existing browser-review environment and browser_stills Chrome discovery.

licensing.notes: Original workspace test code; no third-party code copied.

approval_evidence: 0.4.0, Windows 2026-11-20: twenty cases per profile pass with zero history-dependent pixels; all twenty explicit-legacy fresh references remain identical to 1.9.2. Locality measured 279/228 off-window pixels before, zero after, and 279/228 again with only the clip uniform disabled. Inside-window changes prevent blank interiors passing. No Mac or human anatomy approval.
